items.prompt:
Which is one of the four factors of natural selection?
A) Heritable variation
B) The weather
C) The time of day
D) A person's name

steps: Heritable variation is one of the four factors.

items.prompt:
Individuals compete because
A) resources are limited
B) resources are unlimited
C) they have no needs
D) they never interact

Which individuals tend to reproduce more?
A) Those better suited to the environment
B) Those less suited
C) All equally
D) None
items.answer: A) Those better suited to the environment

items.prompt:
Over generations, helpful traits become
A) more common
B) less common
C) extinct
D) unchanged forever

steps: Helpful traits spread through the population.

items.prompt:
Heritable variation is necessary because
A) selection needs heritable differences to act on and pass on
B) all individuals are identical
C) variation cannot be inherited
D) it stops evolution
items.answer: A) selection needs heritable differences to act on and pass on

steps: Without variation there is nothing to select.

items.prompt:
Better-camouflaged beetles survive better, so over time
A) camouflage becomes more common
B) camouflage disappears
C) nothing changes
D) beetles become plants

steps: The surviving trait spreads over generations.

items.prompt:
Antibiotic resistance spreads in bacteria because
A) resistant bacteria survive the antibiotic and reproduce, passing on resistance
B) bacteria choose to resist
C) the antibiotic creates resistance
D) bacteria do not reproduce
items.answer: A) resistant bacteria survive the antibiotic and reproduce, passing on resistance

items.prompt:
The four factors of natural selection are
A) overproduction, heritable variation, competition for limited resources, and more reproduction of better-suited individuals
B) food, water, air, and sun
C) weather, time, names, and colors
D) only variation
items.answer: A) overproduction, heritable variation, competition for limited resources, and more reproduction of better-suited individuals

steps: These four factors drive natural selection.
